# Lane 2.118: the Players panel on the tracker

## Plan

- Part 1: the controller's change of players and the device's rosters, no screen.
- Part 2: the panel itself (opens by itself on an empty team, both teams, one line of numbers, fix, remove), its words and sizes.
- Part 3: the browser test (empty visiting team, "3 5 10 12 14", lineups, #12 scores, then with the network off), pictures at the four sizes, page-step checks, the whole chain.
- Decision T-330 (pending file); spec T6 §3 says it.

## Part 1

- `tracker-controller.ts`: `changePlayers(changes: PlayerChange[]) → PlayersResult` (ok with `commandIds`, `playerIds`; or `not-scoring`, `invalid` + index, `rule` + index + `problem`, `storage` + `stored`). Same lock, server time, queue and loss handling as `tapWith`; a whole line is checked before any is stored. New player ids from `newPlayerId` (v4).
- Status gains `rosters`: kept rosters + this device's waiting changes. Options gain `rosters: { page, kept, keep }`; `open-tracker-game.ts` passes them (kept = the ones stored before this opening, used only when opening gets no answer).
- Fetching: `TrackerServer.loadRosters` (optional; fetch and storing servers have it), on start, takeOver, `lost` (adds checked before listing), a refused change (second `queue.subscribe`), `backOnline`. Each fetch drops listed adds the server has.
- `roster-changes.ts` (pure, for part 2): `playersPanel(...)` gives each player `waiting`, `clashWith`, `rename`, `takeOff` (with `key`), `readOnly` (final / device), `refused` groups (`refusedChanges`, plays under their add); `numbersOfLine`, `wornOn` (to mark a clash while typing), `deviceProblem`.
- Words: `tracker.players.readOnly.*`, `tracker.players.refused.<problem>` (every problem).
- Core exports `splitTableName`, `namedInState` (games index), so the device splits names as the server does.
- Part 2 must: feed `status.rosters` to the scoring screen at once (it reads the page's rosters now), call `playersPanel` with `status.waiting`, `status.notApplied`, `status.game`, `mode.kind === 'scoring'`.
- Tests: `tracker-controller-players.test.ts` 11, `roster-changes.test.ts` 7; tracker + core games + site 105 files, 1213 passed; check, typecheck, pending decisions 11.
- Distrust: "taken" is told by a change leaving the waiting list neither refused nor listed; one set aside unlisted would show as saved until the next fetch. Starting from the kept rosters on an offline reload (`startFromDevice`) has no test. Only the answer-lost test was seen to fail without its fix.

## Part 2

- `players-panel.tsx` (the sheet: both teams, side by side where two columns of 300 fit; add line; Fix row with number, name, Save, Take off; reasons; refused groups), `players-form.ts` (pure: `lineChanges`, `typedClashes`, `fixChange`, drafts by game in localStorage), `use-players-panel.tsx` (open/shut, opens by itself once per screen when a team is empty and the device scores, words each controller answer), wired in `scoring-screen.tsx` (slots `noPlayers`, `pregame`, `more`). `tracker-opening.tsx` gives the screen `status.rosters` (page's until it has some) and `gameId`. Styles at the end of the log-sheet part of `court.css`, plus one upright-phone rule: while starters are picked each team takes half the place and scrolls by itself.
- Marks for part 3: open by `[data-players-open="more|home|away"]` (none in the pad before tip-off: the scoring-screen test found it pushed the pad's words out on an upright phone); `[data-players-panel]`, `[data-players-team=side]`, type in `[data-players-line=side]` / `[data-players-name=side]`, tap `[data-players-add=side]`; rows `[data-player-row=id]` with `data-clash`, `data-waiting`; `[data-player-fix=id]` then `[data-player-number=id]`, `[data-player-name-box=id]` (readonly for league players), `[data-player-save=id]`, `[data-player-takeoff=id]`, `[data-player-reason=id]`; answers `[data-players-said=side]`; `[data-players-read-only=final|device]`, `[data-players-refused]`, `[data-players-banner]`, `[data-players-close]` (Escape shuts too).
- Tests: `players-panel.test.ts` 9 (static markup), `players-form.test.ts` 6; tracker folder 52 files, 711 passed; site + tracker 804; check, typecheck, test:web 270, pending decisions 11.
- Sizes, measured once with a scratch script (17 a side, next build): no sideways scroll at all five sizes, panel and screen; every panel target at least 44 x 44; panel teams side by side at 844, 820 and 1180 wide, stacked at 390; the last away row reachable by scrolling the panel at each size. Picking starters: before the upright-phone rule, at 390 x 664 the second team had 0 tiles in view; after it, 5 of each team in view at 390 x 664 and 10 of each at 390 x 844; tablets show all 17 of each.
- Left for part 3: the browser test and the pictures; the auto-open, the reload of a draft and `status.rosters` reaching the tiles are seen only in code and unit tests, not in a browser test. Distrust: on a stacked phone the away team's add line is 17 rows down (reachable, not near); a bench line half stored (storage error) keeps only the numbers not stored, untested; several numbers with a name are sent and refused as `invalid` with one sentence.

## Part 3

- The lead's decision built: a jump "Go to the away team: {team}" (`[data-players-jump=away]`) at the top of the panel, shown only under 680 wide where the teams stack; each add line sits above its list. Several numbers with a name are refused on the device with a sentence (`lineProblem`, `tracker.players.numbersWithName`), never sent. Tests: `players-panel.test.ts` 10, `players-form.test.ts` 7.
- `tests/browser/players-panel-test.mjs`, 38 checks, two fresh servers, the visiting Bears marked left by the owner (yesterday) so their roster is empty: with the signal (opens by itself, "3 5 10 12 14", numbers with a name refused, 17 a side measured at the four sizes and while picking at 390 x 664, #12 on tile, log and public page, the rosters answer another device gets, #14 made #41 after three plays on tile, log and public page, no take-off for a league player or one with a basket, with the reason) and with no signal in a season switched to unique numbers (adds and basket wait, reload keeps players and the half-typed line, #3 typed twice marked on both and taken, all saved after, nothing refused or "not saved"). Passed 5 runs in a row after merging `build/stage-1`. No product fault found.
- Pictures (`PLAYERS_PANEL_PICTURES=.local/look-2.118`): the four sizes; two looked at, nothing plainly wrong.
- Pins: harmful-text types the attack into the panel's line and name box (FIELDS `players-line`, `players-name`); no new page, so no page-step row or nothing-unfinished entry.
- Checks: check, typecheck, test:web 270, tracker + site vitest 806; whole browser chain 63 of 63 in chunks.
- Left: spec T6 §3 not yet updated for the jump and the numbers-with-name refusal (lead). Distrust: "second device" is the rosters answer fetched, not a second browser; the jump's 680 break is measured only at the four sizes; the refusal sentence in the hook has no unit test (browser test only).
